common_defaults.reason: Every case executes both the inventoried pathname and PATH lookup through cshell string/file/stdin modes; invocation/resource boundaries remain unqualified.

Private files, C locale, bounded streams, resource limits, ordinary errors and owned process cleanup. Full utility syntax guidelines, non-C locales, capacity, storage/read/write faults and signal timing remain unqualified.

retained_conditions.reason: 4096-byte buffer, failed output pathname, synchronized SIGHUP cwd/HOME recovery and SIGINT command-mode recovery. Temp backing-store faults, capacity exhaustion and other signal timings remain open.

optional_reproducers.reason: Strict stdout ?\n and unchanged buffer recovery. macOS emits on stderr; GNU adds a newline. Keep failures outside the declared passing subset, without gap allowances.
